chapters.copy:
Engineering Intelligence Into Systems

Flagship Initiative
QuantEra AI
From Financial Research to Computational Research Infrastructure
QuantEra AI extends the research philosophy behind Twods Capital into software.
Rather than allowing an LLM to generate financial conclusions directly, the platform separates computation from narration.
Financial metrics, company fundamentals, relationships, and quantitative calculations are generated through deterministic software. LLMs operate primarily at the interpretation and explanation layer.
Investment Thesis
The system is built around three principles:
Evidence before narrative.
Every conclusion should trace back to observable financial or market data.
Deterministic computation before generation.
Ratios, metrics, and quantitative relationships are computed in software rather than delegated to an LLM.
Abstention over fabrication.
If sufficient evidence cannot be retrieved or calculated, the system should fail closed rather than create unsupported financial claims.

chapters.heading: CHAPTER 5: PROJECTS & SKILLS

Featured Projects

01: Verdict
Calibrated Abstention for Credit Underwriting
Problem
AI-assisted underwriting becomes dangerous when a model is forced to produce a decision despite uncertain, missing, or out-of-distribution financial evidence.
Solution
Verdict is a credit-underwriting agent designed around field-level calibrated abstention. It extracts financial facts with provenance, performs deterministic underwriting calculations, propagates uncertainty through the workflow, and routes low-confidence cases to human review.
Core Architecture
Document ingestion
→ Structured financial extraction
→ Provenance tracking
→ Deterministic DSCR / leverage calculations
→ Hierarchical confidence propagation
→ Adaptive conformal thresholds
→ OOD detection
→ Human-review routing
Results
6.9% realized miscoverage against a 10% target
76.1% of fields automated
Routing violations reduced to 14.7% vs. 57.2% baseline
88 automated tests
Technologies
TypeScript · Next.js · PostgreSQL · LLM Orchestration · Conformal Prediction · Human-in-the-Loop AI
Live: verdict-bice.vercel.app

02: NorthPort
High-Scale SEC Form N-PORT Validation Engine
Problem
Regulatory filings contain millions of structured fields where schema validity alone cannot identify financially inconsistent or logically impossible data.
Solution
NorthPort implements a two-tier validation architecture for SEC Form N-PORT filings.
Tier 1: Structural and schema validation
Tier 2: Deterministic financial and cross-field validation rules
Scale
1.3M+ holdings processed
4,024 filings evaluated
Approximately 7,000 holdings / second
Approximately 11,600 violations surfaced
Approximately 4,800 false positives eliminated
Technologies
Python · FastAPI · SEC N-PORT · Validation Systems · Financial Data Engineering
Live: north-port.vercel.app

03: QuantEra AI
Evidence-Grounded Financial Research Engine
Problem
General-purpose LLMs can discuss finance fluently while still producing incorrect calculations, stale fundamentals, or unsupported claims.
Solution
QuantEra separates deterministic financial computation from language-model narration and requires generated explanations to operate on structured financial evidence.
Core Architecture
Market / SEC Data
→ Data normalization
→ Deterministic calculations
→ Retrieval
→ Context construction
→ LLM explanation
→ Validation / fail-closed checks
Result
95.8% field-level accuracy when validated against SEC 10-K data across eight large-cap companies.
Technologies
Python · FastAPI · RAG · LLMs · yfinance · Finnhub · Cytoscape.js

A BNPL marketplace needs to combine merchant discovery, user eligibility, underwriting, payment-plan generation, and reliable communication between services.

Built a backend platform supporting merchant discovery and Pay-in-4 / 6 / 12 / 24 financing flows with staged underwriting and signed webhook infrastructure.
